name: ab-duplicates-complements
description: Two lanes report one shared defect, one complementary defect, and one review-checkout access failure that must remain operational telemetry.

findings.title: Permanent failures retry forever
findings.body: dispatch() puts every 4xx response back on the queue without incrementing the terminal-attempt counter, so a permanent 401 loops indefinitely.

findings.title: Negative ages pass validation
findings.body: parse_age() accepts -1 because it checks only the upper bound; downstream contribution math then uses an impossible age.

findings.title: 401 jobs are requeued without a terminal attempt
findings.body: The permanent-error branch requeues unauthorized jobs forever because no terminal attempt is recorded.

findings.title: Registry file could not be inspected
findings.body: The registry file was not present/readable in the review checkout, so review tooling could not verify the mapping.
